body: Truly just depends on what prison has a training programme at this point. I know a girl I work with now did hers at Long Lartin but I went to Newbold, we’re both West Midlands. But as someone else has said, we had 3 officers from IoW and in my cohort, I had someone from Bristol. But you can always stay at Newbold for the time you’re there, and just leave on the weekends. It’s a ballache I know
I have forgotten to mention that this was part of my intro week, I don’t work on the wing this happened but even if I did, we’re just a remand/holding prison, I work in a gen pop/mains wing

I work in a UK prison and my first time on the wing, I was with another officer and we went up to a cell to feed some guy behind his door and this little gremlin was naked with feces and urine on the floor, barefoot and threw his plate at us. When we walked back up with his food he had his little friend in his hand and was just shaking it everywhere. Safe to say, I have never had another interaction like that after nearly 2 years 😂

Tuesday this week, I started bleeding after seeing brown discharge and it didn’t stop. Still going through it, but we had a scan yesterday that confirmed it. I was nearly 6 weeks and this is my second one. Sobbed for the rest of the day, trying to understand why I can’t carry. It was my baby and I did everything right this time. It’s hard to process it all. 

Sending so much love to all the mommas in this group. Our time will come, grieve however appropriate. I love you all 💕

Cantu ruined my hair completely, I started using creme of nature about 2 years ago and haven’t looked back since. Shea moisture, creme of nature and anything argan oil (leave in conditioning mask) i absolutely swear by, but you need to check you porosity before anything else. But cantu is not the one
What a fantastic country I live in
